pos.personaBrief: Botafogo averaged 54.6% possession but circulated at the back and attacked vertically, with fast transitions and long balls (FotMob, TFA, Drible de Corpo); they dropped into a 4-4-2 and counter-attacked.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical proposal exploiting front-men speed, many long balls and fast transitions (FotMob, Drible de Corpo), yet calm build-up from the back until the press triggers (TFA).

est.personaBrief: Artur Jorge likes forming pairs in build-up, sees closeness as a shortcut, uses position swaps, a false nine and full-backs moving into midfield (Drible de Corpo).

lar.personaBrief: Top crossers in the Brasileirao (5.8 accurate per 90, FotMob) with wingers Luiz Henrique and Savarino in a 4-2-3-1 and long diagonal balls to the false nine.

blo.personaBrief: High press early and stated 'pressionar muito alto' (Trivela, May), but later hardly pressed, dropped into a 4-4-2 block and a six-man line in the final (FotMob, Drible de Corpo).

mar.personaBrief: No marking source; the compact 4-4-2 block and area-protecting defending point to zonal organization with no dedicated man-markers.

pla.personaBrief: Stated 'um Botafogo sempre igual, contra quem quer que fosse' and a model imposed on arrival (4-4-2 to 4-2-3-1), with in-game tweaks like the back three in the final.

res.personaBrief: Wants a team that is 'viva, alegre e fluida' and attacking, but in the final with a lead he closed with a six-man line and three centre-backs; best defence in the league.

sis.personaBrief: Collective approach with rotation, 28 players contributing, a system that is the same against anyone; stars like Almada and Luiz Henrique have defined roles and drop into the block.

jog.personaBrief: Pace in transition, physical focal point Igor Jesus, midfield runners, plus individual flair and creative attackers like Almada (Hudl, FotMob).

bas.personaBrief: Squad built on expensive signings and seasoned players (Hulk-type experience, Marlon Freitas, Gregore, Vargas), champion with experience; no academy emphasis in the evidence.

lid.personaBrief: Manager balances 'dar uma dura' with 'carinho' (Itatiaia), talks to Luiz Henrique and Almada mid-game, rotates the squad and applies the same system to all.
